entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""You must be-""
entries.dialogueText: "You must be-"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We both know that I will have a ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "We both know that I will have a target on my back after this. I need that immunity."
entries.menuText: "We both know that I will have a target on my back after this. I need that immunity."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""Of course. This is all about you,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. This is all about you, Mr. President, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""With all due respect, Mr. Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, Mr. President. I think you got ahead of yourself. Especially by trying to remove your impeachment procedure and giving yourself immunity. This is too much."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""So that you can create your own *O..."
entries.dialogueText: "So that you can create your own *Old Guard* and kick everyone with opposing views? The Judiciary must be independent, Mr. President and the clause you removed was a prerequisite of that."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""The same assembly that your party..."
entries.dialogueText: "The same assembly that your party controls, by the way."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're still not seeing the comple..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're still not seeing the complete picture. This proposal is a step towards democratization."
entries.menuText: "You're still not seeing the complete picture. This proposal is a step towards democratization."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We both know that the Old Guard th..."
entries.dialogueText: "We both know that the Old Guard that dominates and obstructs the court needs to be dealt with."
entries.menuText: "We both know that the Old Guard that dominates and obstructs the court needs to be dealt with."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not going to deny that. That i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not going to deny that. That is the situation."
entries.menuText: "I'm not going to deny that. That is the situation."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Therefore, you will vote yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Therefore, you will vote yes."
entries.menuText: "Therefore, you will vote yes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't get ahead of yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't get ahead of yourself."
entries.menuText: "Don't get ahead of yourself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm sure we can make a deal.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure we can make a deal."
entries.menuText: "I'm sure we can make a deal."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""Mr. President is aiming to destroy..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President is aiming to destroy the Court and he needs us to do so."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""That's a start.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's a start."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We don't want that.""
entries.dialogueText: "We don't want that."
entries.menuText: "We don't want that."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""I doubt that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I doubt that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She measured me with her eyes."
entries.dialogueText: She measured me with her eyes.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's why we have you here.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's why we have you here."
entries.menuText: "That's why we have you here."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""I know.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""I'm not here to make a deal, Mr. P..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not here to make a deal, Mr. President. I'm here to talk."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""...But it pains me to say that you..."
entries.dialogueText: "...But it pains me to say that your proposal has a very low chance of getting through the Supreme Court."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""I hope you're not thinking about b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you're not thinking about bribing a Supreme Court Justice."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""First of all... Congratulations wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "First of all... Congratulations with the vote in the Grand National Assembly."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""It is you, Mr. President, who shou..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is you, Mr. President, who shouldn't get ahead of himself."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stared at me for a few seconds...."
entries.dialogueText: She stared at me for a few seconds. She seemed to be taken aback by my response.

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""First of all, I want to congratula..."
entries.dialogueText: "First of all, I want to congratulate you on the successful vote in the Grand National Assembly..."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Mrs. Edmonds... Let's calm down.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mrs. Edmonds... Let's calm down."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Bribe? Who do you think we are, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Bribe? Who do you think we are, Mrs. Edmonds?"

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""I admire your struggle. Especially..."
entries.dialogueText: "I admire your struggle. Especially because you were strong enough to include concessions from your side."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not if you support us.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not if you support us."
entries.menuText: "Not if you support us."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""Why should I vote for a proposal t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why should I vote for a proposal that will take away my immunity as a Justice? Was this the promised reform? Impeaching a Justice with the decision of the Assembly?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You oppose this because of that on..."
entries.dialogueText: "You oppose this because of that one simple clause?"
entries.menuText: "You oppose this because of that one simple clause?"

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""You made a very clever package, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "You made a very clever package, Mr. President. The real gain here is your immunity from impeachment. And..."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""You take away our immunity and giv..."
entries.dialogueText: "You take away our immunity and give it to yourself, and I'm opposing because of a little simple clause?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But you like the proposal?""
entries.dialogueText: "But you like the proposal?"
entries.menuText: "But you like the proposal?"

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""Democratization!?""
entries.dialogueText: "Democratization!?"

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""What about it? You are already try..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about it? You are already trying to take our right to vote on constitutional legislature and also open a way to impeach us, are you not?"

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""You are really brave, Mr. Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are really brave, Mr. President. Trying to go against Tarquin Soll's member of honor rights, huh?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And what do you think about the pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what do you think about the proposal itself?"
entries.menuText: "And what do you think about the proposal itself?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not if you support us.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not if you support us."
entries.menuText: "Not if you support us."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's why we have you here.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's why we have you here."
entries.menuText: "That's why we have you here."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""You know it's true, Mrs. Morgna.""
entries.dialogueText: "You know it's true, Mrs. Morgna."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""Proper? You are already trying to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Proper? You are already trying to take our right to vote on constitutional legislature and also open a way to impeach us, are you not?"

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""This law will not only apply to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "This law will not only apply to them but all Justices, Mr. President. Who will protect our rights if you take away our immunity?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She sighed."
entries.dialogueText: She sighed.

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""....Using Soll's membership laws f..."
entries.dialogueText: "....Using Soll's membership laws for your own benefit? I have to say I don't really like this proposal, no."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""You need our wing to vote for you...."
entries.dialogueText: "You need our wing to vote for you. Otherwise all of your hard work will be in vain."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""....No. I don't like the proposal.""
entries.dialogueText: "....No. I don't like the proposal."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""To start with, I think it's disres..."
entries.dialogueText: "To start with, I think it's disrespectful."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""I am perfectly aware that you need..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am perfectly aware that you need us."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""You are packaging it as a democrat..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are packaging it as a democratic reform, yet it smells like an attack against the Supreme Court."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""You need our wing to vote for you...."
entries.dialogueText: "You need our wing to vote for you. Otherwise all of your hard work will be in vain."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""So the current situation is clear...."
entries.dialogueText: "So the current situation is clear..."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""You are right.""
entries.dialogueText: "You are right."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""But now you face the Supreme Court..."
entries.dialogueText: "But now you face the Supreme Court. And it pains me to say that your proposal has a very low chance of getting through it."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Mrs. Edmonds...""
entries.dialogueText: "Mrs. Edmonds..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And what about the powers of the S..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what about the powers of the Supreme Court?"
entries.menuText: "And what about the powers of the Supreme Court?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We need proper balance of power, M..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need proper balance of power, Mrs. Edmonds. Try to see the bigger picture."
entries.menuText: "We need proper balance of power, Mrs. Edmonds. Try to see the bigger picture."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""You know it's true, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "You know it's true, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds

entries.dialogueText: "You are aiming to destroy the Court and you need us to do so."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""Why should I vote for a proposal t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why should I vote for a proposal that will take away my immunity as a Justice? Was this the promised reform? Removing Justices however you see fit?"

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""You are expanding the powers of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are expanding the powers of the president, which already is very powerful. "

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""First of all, I want to congratula..."
entries.dialogueText: "First of all, I want to congratulate you on the successful vote in the Grand National Assembly..."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""...But it pains me to say that you..."
entries.dialogueText: "...But it pains me to say that your *updated* proposal has a very low chance of getting through the Supreme Court."

entries.dialogueText: "That's why we have you here."
entries.menuText: "That's why we have you here."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""You think that's enough?""
entries.dialogueText: "You think that's enough?"

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""What I think really doesn't matter..."
entries.dialogueText: "What I think really doesn't matter with a proposal like this."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""Changing Article 6 and 7? Removing..."
entries.dialogueText: "Changing Article 6 and 7? Removing 'Sord' from the Constitution?"

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""What were you even thinking?""
entries.dialogueText: "What were you even thinking?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The discrimination and oppression..."
entries.dialogueText: "The discrimination and oppression that many Bludish people face in this country."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Assembly proved many wrong by..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Assembly proved many wrong by passing it, Ms. Edmonds. The atmosphere in this country is now changing."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You know those changes are about e..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know those changes are about equality and rights, Justice Edmonds."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you not approve of those?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you not approve of those?"

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""You know you need the other justic..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know you need the other justices to vote for it too, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""Try explaining that to the Sollist..."
entries.dialogueText: "Try explaining that to the Sollists and the Sordists."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""I thought you were a tactical man,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you were a tactical man, Mr. President. But you decided to gamble with your reforms."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""What matters is the atmosphere of..."
entries.dialogueText: "What matters is the atmosphere of the Supreme Court, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""But before we get bogged down in d..."
entries.dialogueText: "But before we get bogged down in details, I must say I find your proposal disrespectful."

entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""And now you need our wing to vote..."
entries.dialogueText: "And now you need our wing to vote for you. Otherwise all of your hard work will be in vain."

entries.dialogueText: "But before we get bogged down in details, I must say this."

entries.dialogueText: "You are really brave. Trying to go against Tarquin Soll's member of honor rights, huh?"

entries.dialogueText: "I admire your struggle. Especially because you were strong enough to include concessions from your side."
